_comment: Bait-comment keywords (docs/spec/detection-rules.md §3.1, #27): matched case-insensitively anywhere after a '#' on the same line. Each pattern is a regex fragment (Rust `regex` syntax: no lookaround, no backreferences). Only words ClickFix lures use and ordinary comments rarely do; Japanese 認証 and Korean 인증 alone are too common (認証トークン, 인증서), so they need a following ID.

languages.note: also covers most es/pt/fr/de/it/id/tr spellings (roboter, verificación, humano…)
robô does not contain robot; vérification has an accent
